app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Hold sideways. A: impulse / hold for 6 Hz motion and slow drift. Shake: 2.5x impulse. B: animated region inversion and background echo. 1: palette. 2: ring / cross / spike / ribbon space. D-pad: directional impulse and feedback twist. Plus: 55 degree telephoto target. Minus: 105 degree wide angle target. Plus and Minus together: reset. HOME: exit. No sensor bar required.
